method: GitHub REST API (stars, last push, archived, license), Hugging Face model cards (weight licences), local installation and execution. Resource figures are measured on this host unless marked as vendor requirements.

repositories.name: PaddleOCR
repositories.commercial_restrictions: None for the tested PP-OCRv6 pipeline; Apache-2.0 permits commercial use.
repositories.install: pip install paddlepaddle==3.3.1 paddleocr==3.7.0; macOS arm64 wheel available; Linux CPU/GPU wheels available.
repositories.hardware: CPU works; GPU recommended for throughput. Measured peak RSS 6.8 GB on a 20-page run (models + Python), median latency reported in benchmark.
repositories.notes: PP-OCRv6 medium det+rec, English, text-line output; tables not reconstructed natively.

repositories.name: Docling
repositories.weight_license: Layout (heron) and TableFormerV2: Apache-2.0; CodeFormulaV2: CDLA-Permissive-2.0
repositories.commercial_restrictions: Permissive code and model licences; no paid API required. Optional VLM pipelines have their own model licences.
repositories.install: pip install docling==2.150.0; models downloaded from Hugging Face on first use (~hundreds of MB).
repositories.hardware: CPU and Apple MPS work. Warm page latency measured; cold start includes model load.
repositories.notes: Markdown + table grid output; strong layout/table reconstruction on financial statements.

repositories.name: MinerU
repositories.code_license: Apache-2.0 with additional terms (commercial licence required above stated revenue/user thresholds)
repositories.commercial_restrictions: Code is Apache-2.0 plus additional terms; model weights are AGPL-3.0. Commercial deployment must be reviewed by legal; the extra terms require a paid licence above the published thresholds.
repositories.install: pip install mineru==3.0.9; first run downloads PDF-Extract-Kit models (~1.1 GB cached here).
repositories.hardware: CPU pipeline works; GPU strongly preferred. CLI spawns a local API service per invocation, adding latency.
repositories.notes: Pipeline backend, English; markdown + table output.

repositories.name: olmOCR
repositories.commercial_restrictions: Permissive, but the reference pipeline requires vLLM and CUDA GPUs.
repositories.install: pip install olmocr==0.4.27; model download ~15 GB (7B).
repositories.hardware: Not runnable on this Apple Silicon host: vLLM has no macOS/MPS backend. Would need an NVIDIA GPU (>=24 GB VRAM recommended for the 7B model).
repositories.blocker: No CUDA GPU on the execution host; vLLM does not support Apple MPS. The engine is documented but excluded from the numeric ranking.

repositories.name: OCRmyPDF
repositories.commercial_restrictions: MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft; permitted in commercial products if modifications to MPL files are shared.
repositories.install: brew/apt install ocrmypdf + tesseract; Python package also available.
repositories.hardware: CPU only; adds a PDF text layer and preserves the original image.
repositories.notes: Benchmarked as a wrapper around Tesseract on a reduced page set.

repositories.name: Tesseract
repositories.install: brew install tesseract (5.5.2 here) or apt install tesseract-ocr.
repositories.hardware: CPU only, low memory (~160 MB measured); no table model.
repositories.notes: Baseline OCR engine; fast but weaker on dense table layouts.

repositories.name: Unstructured
repositories.weight_license: Core library Apache-2.0; optional hi_res models/dependencies carry their own licences; hosted API is paid.
repositories.commercial_restrictions: Open-source core is permissive; the managed platform and some model bundles are commercial. Not a standalone OCR engine: it orchestrates PDF/image parsing and OCR backends.
repositories.install: pip install unstructured[pdf]; hi_res requires extra model downloads and detectron2/onnx stack.
repositories.hardware: CPU/GPU depending on strategy; fast strategy is CPU-only and does not OCR scanned pages.
repositories.blocker: Not benchmarked as an OCR engine because it delegates OCR to Tesseract/PaddleOCR and its hi_res model stack could not be installed reliably on this host within the run. Evaluated at the architecture level only.
